newsitem.title: USA: EA Industries Inc Q2 net loss of $7.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: EA Industries Inc Q2 net loss of $7.2 mln.

text.p: EA Industries Inc said Monday that sales for the second quarter of 1997 were $16,677,000, up, as expected, from $14,625,000 in the first quarter of 1997, although the company reported a net loss in the period of $7,236,000, after a one-time charge.
EA also said it posted a book-to-bill ratio in excess of 1.8 for the second quarter, building a backlog of over $46,000,000 by quarter's end, primarily from existing customers.
The company also said it expected a profitable run rate, perhaps sometimes in the second half of the year.

EA's net loss for the second quarter of $7,236,000 included non-recurring charges of over $4,000,000, stemming from the its decision to revise its strategy to focus on Electronics Contract Manufacturing.

In a statement accompanying the earnings release, chief executive Frank Brandenberg, stated "The responsiveness of sales volumes to our new strategy was faster and greater than expected. Sales levels are still below our break even point, but clearly going in the right direction. We have dramatically cut expenses and divested of those activities outside our stated strategy."
EA Industries is a contract manufacturer serving the electronics industry.
